guard: cotal config resolves each preference in the named order, refuses a stale or invalid write and never resets an invalid file, stops every command over one, and color, the personas editor and the detach key read the saved preferences
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/config-preferences.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary, and its in-process cells import the workspace build, so each mutation rebuilds the binary and its packages and the restore rebuilds them back.
